icon_sources: PokeAPI/sprites: generation-vii/icons for species 1..809; generation-viii/icons for 810..898; 20 named alternate forms
modifications: Green PKSM storage backgrounds precomposited from original UI PNGs; icons cropped/centered to 34x30 and native 15-color palettes; independent placeholder and egg icons. No raw Pokemon data bundled.
experience_data: growth-rates.json maps species growth rates and experience thresholds from PokeAPI/data/v2/csv/pokemon_species.csv and experience.csv.
